quote: Sandvik has secured an order from Glencore to supply three DR413i rotary blasthole drill rigs for the restart of the Bajo de la Alumbrera copper mine in Argentina. The order was booked in Q1 2026. The first DR413i is scheduled to arrive in Argentina in April with the remaining two following in Q4 2026. Additionally, Sandvik will provide rebuild services to Glencore for three D75KS rotary blasthole drill rigs and three DP1500 crawled-based surface drill rigs, as well as labor and parts for maintenance of the whole fleet.
